text: Every harvest deserves to arrive fresh.
Tell AniRoute what you're carrying, and where it's going.
It finds the real roads to your market,
and scores each one for time, crop, and road safety.
Choose the gentlest road for your harvest.
Then follow it, every kilometer of the way.
Your phone's camera spots cracked, damaged road, in real time.
Confirm with a tap, and AniRoute finds a safer way.
Protect the harvest, on the way to market.
